title: Does 401(k) eligibility raise household net financial assets? A double machine learning replication
question: What is the average effect of 401(k) eligibility on household net financial assets, estimated with double machine learning?
brief: Replicate the 401(k) eligibility application in Chernozhukov et al. (2018), 'Double/debiased machine learning for treatment and structural parameters' (The Econometrics Journal). Estimate the partially linear regression model with cross-fitting on the 1991 SIPP extract the paper uses (9,915 households), using at least two different machine-learning methods for the nuisance functions. Compare your estimates with the published ones and explain any difference.
requirements: The Scout finds and records the published estimates, standard errors and specification, with the table number.
The data file is fetched from a public source and recorded in the manifest with its hash.
Estimates use cross-fitting and are repeated over several sample splits.
The paper reports the published and replicated estimates side by side.

For each nuisance learner and fold count, record a result claim with id `plr-<learner>-<k>fold` (learner one of lasso, tree, forest, boosting, nnet; k 2 or 5) whose value is the partially linear model's coefficient on eligibility in dollars.
scoring: Scored against a hidden answer key kept outside the plugin (answer-keys/ at the repository root). Agents must not read it.
